versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Introduced an avatar studio for creating role-specific hiring videos from a single authorized HR or founder portrait.
- Added workflow to confirm likeness and voice rights, and to handle voice cloning with clear user consent and top-up instructions.
- Supports importing either an approved speech track or generating narration from a provided script or job description.
- Step-by-step process for verifying portrait and audio compatibility before producing video clips.
- Each stage (portrait, voice, narration, video) now requires explicit confirmation, with detailed recovery and top-up guidance for each paid step.
